evidence.quote: The manuscript has not changed by a single word.
The recurring researcher in the chapters that follow, Elena Varga, is a composite case rather than a real person.
A paper can contain a robust measurement, a fragile causal interpretation, a speculative theoretical section, and a mistaken citation at the same time.
Such a system would not create certainty. It would create provenance.
A system can publish perfect provenance and still undersupply replication if careers and grants reward novelty almost exclusively.
A generated graph must never become more authoritative than the text and data from which it was derived.
The solution is not to abolish credibility. It is to make credibility more granular, more dynamic, and more inspectable.
